_meta.description: Ground truth for Phase 9 evaluation. Entries map the live evaluation fixtures under data/fixtures/ to expected routing, extraction, and summary targets.
_meta.notes: Edge-case and scanned OCR fixtures live in subdirectories but are excluded from the main Phase 9 EvalRunner because it currently treats processing failures as test failures.

CBC with differential: all values within normal limits
BMP: glucose mildly elevated at 102 (likely non-fasting)
Inflammatory markers (ESR, CRP) normal
Coagulation studies normal — cleared for procedures
Urinalysis normal
EKG: normal sinus rhythm, no ischemic changes
Chest X-ray: normal, no acute cardiopulmonary process
MRI lumbar: moderate left paracentral disc herniation L4-L5, 7mm x 12mm, compressing left L5 nerve root
EMG: acute left L5 radiculopathy with active denervation
No peripheral neuropathy, no L4 or S1 involvement
